description: Moves, rescales, restyles or reconfigures a drawing view in place: at (its centre, sheet mm), scale (its own) or sheet_scale (follow the sheet's), display, configuration (a model view's). Values not given stay; moved without at, a view keeps its centre. A projected view is drawn at its parent's scale and moves only along its parent's centre line (SOLIDWORKS silently keeps the aligned coordinate): moving it off that line is refused naming the parent. Each value is recorded before and put back on failure. Checked by measuring: every value reads back (the centre within 0.01 mm, the scale exactly), what it draws equals the model's box projected at its scale within 0.01 mm (orthographic views; inside it for others), the views projected from it are still on its centre lines, and the model is unchanged.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

view.description: The view: a reference (r1.view.…) or its name (Drawing View1).

x.description: Mm to the right of the sheet's lower-left corner.

y.description: Mm above the sheet's lower-left corner.

at.description: Where its centre goes, sheet mm from the sheet's lower-left corner.

numerator.description: The first number of the ratio, more than 0.

denominator.description: The second number of the ratio, more than 0.

scale.description: Its own scale (a model view's). Not with sheet_scale.

sheet_scale.description: true to make it follow its sheet's scale. Not with scale.

display.description: hidden_lines_visible, hidden_lines_removed, wireframe, shaded or shaded_with_edges.

configuration.description: The model's configuration a model view shows.
